qc/runs/kittle-2026-10-09-r7/raw-evidence-index.json (entry list; no agent-image build entry for these bytes)
Actual run: docker build of a scratchpad copy of the frozen environment/ context (image qc-r7-row15-agent:tmp, since removed)
evidence: environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template's environment/Dockerfile (diff empty). Line 1 `FROM node:22-bookworm-slim` (tag-pinned, resolved locally to node@sha256:83f487e0...; no digest pin, which matches the template and check-dockerfiles.py's tag/@version pinning rule). Lines 3/9-11: `ENV NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules` and `npm install -g express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1`, exactly the two deps in solution/app/package.json and the only non-builtin requires in server.js:10-11; tests/Dockerfile installs the same versions with the same NODE_PATH. Lines 14-15 `COPY instructions/ /instructions/`, `COPY assets/ /assets/`; line 16 `chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets`; /app mkdir + git init + .gitkeep commit; no COPY of solution/ or tests/; no [environment].docker_image in task.toml; solve.sh only copies files (no install). Actual run on 9 Oct 2026: frozen context built cleanly; with --network none as uid 65534 under env -i PATH+NODE_PATH, node v22.23.2 required express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1 and opened an in-memory DB (sqlite 3.50.4), proving the native binding is preinstalled and needs no grade-time network; /assets/seed_data.json and the three /instructions notes are world-readable; /app contains only .git and .gitkeep with one commit 'Initialize task workspace' and a clean tree (as root). Integration.md:3 accurately tells the agent Express and better-sqlite3 are preinstalled via NODE_PATH. Weak-app probe: an app needing an extra npm package could pass only if the agent installs it into /app/node_modules during its public-network session, which test.sh's symlink rule tolerates; that is an agent choice, not an image defect. Conforming-alternative probe: an app using only Node built-ins plus the two declared deps runs offline in this image; none found that would fail because of the image. Minor Note-level observation: base is tag-pinned rather than digest-pinned (template-controlled, not to be edited). Container/image removed after the check.
